notes: Composite Red Bull is a fraction of the original Melbourne wordmark's footprint — the original wordmark spans the full strip height, ours sits as a small badge in a sea of empty blue. That is the dominant artifact: not paint quality, but scale. With the wordmark at correct scale the surface would read more naturally. Brightness is acceptable for the surface but slightly dim; faint edge reflex on the bull rings under inspection. No on-court contact shadow grounds the logo, so it floats. Jitter is well-controlled across motion strips.
